Coordinator: fetch-policy P1 status.
- cc-sync/fetch-policy @ f4da923; reposync cc-sync/rs-lfs-fetch-gate @ f804de6. worktree.FetchGate now serves both VerifyOptions.FetchOrigin and RestoreOptions.FetchLFS; ErrFetchDeferred defers the fetch.
- Consumer background passes gate every origin fetch through netgate.Run: policy re-read right before the fetch, git process group cancelled mid-flight. Pickup gates its LFS fetch the same way.
- A deferred checkpoint records Missing + MissingPrerequisites (never Ready or failed) and resumes within ~1s of the policy clearing, including a silent manual-metered edit.
- Refutation: 2 rounds found 5 defects, all reproduced failing-first and fixed. A final neutral-wording correctness review is running (Run wf_3f61dc9b-ad8).
- Merge notes:
  - reposync verify.go is also touched by rs-fix-verify (L1-2b/L1-3b); the final merge reconciles them.
  - cc-sync's reposync pin must end on the final worktree-snapshot commit, not the lane pseudo-version.
